newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HOIU LIISING MAY PROFIT 1.33 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: HOIU LIISING MAY PROFIT 1.33 MLN KROONS.

text.p: The Hoiupank Liising leasing arm of second-largest bank Hoiupank said on Wednesday that its profit in May was 1.33 million kroons versus 2.85 million kroons in April.
Hoiupank Liising planned to raise its earlier 1997 profit estimate of 12 million kroons to 16.3 million kroons, sales director Rasmus Kulla told a news conference.
Kulla said that the Estonian leasing market has grown quicker than estimated and so have the assets of Hoiupank Liising.
Its leasing portfolio rose in May 70.4 million kroons to 438.1 million kroons. The portfolio has grown 117 percent during the current year.
